game_concept: A adventure race set in Mt. Pyre – Molten Bridge, a bridge over magma: the ember mage must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Unit Trader: Convert units using expressions so each trade of obsidian shards is fair.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Molten Bridge: a bridge over magma
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Read a rectangle's width and height. Calculate its area and display the result. Test dataset 9: {'width': 10, 'height': 11}; {'width': 12, 'height': 2}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Unit Trader' (Week 2 slot 14), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Molten Bridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the cooling vent by solving code steps involving fair_trades that move the ember mage forward.
source_win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
source_lose_condition: The rival reaches the cooling vent first, or lives reach 0.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
